headline: Revenue is down ₹26 lakh a month, driven mainly by North-West delivery failures.
body: Warehouse WH-07 backlogs pushed late deliveries that made a key enterprise account halt orders entirely [E1]. Rising complaints and a shrinking enterprise base compounded the damage as customers cited a competitor's faster delivery [E3]. North-West alone accounts for most of the total revenue drop.

actions.action: Add 3PL overflow capacity to clear WH-07 backlog
actions.expected_impact: Restore SLA and stop enterprise account losses
actions.monitoring: Track daily SLA % and WH-07 backlog size

what_could_change: If SLA recovers and enterprise accounts resume orders within weeks, this confirms delivery delays as the cause.
caveats: Marketing conversion is also weak but has no direct evidence linking it to the drop yet.
escalation_brief: North-West enterprise accounts are actively churning to a competitor's faster delivery service; immediate operations fix needed to prevent further contract losses.
